questions.question: Complete the sentence correctly: 'Never before ______ such a breathtaking view from this vantage point.'
Which sentence correctly uses a cleft structure to emphasize the time? '_________ was at midnight that the alarm was triggered.'
Choose the correct conditional form: 'If I _______ the opportunity, I would have taken it.'
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood? 'The committee demands that he _______ the report immediately.'
Identify the correct ellipsis: 'She is a talented musician, _______ a professional athlete.'
